spans.s: गृहणी [gṛhaṇī], Sour gruel made from the fermentations of rice water.
गृहम् [gṛham], [गृह्यते धर्माचरणाय, ग्रह् गेहार्थे क Tv.]
A house, dwelling, habitation, mansion; न गृहं गृहमित्याहुर्गृहिणी गृह- मुच्यते
is sometimes erroneously cited as an illustration).
The life of a householder; न हि सति कुलधुर्ये सूर्यवंश्या गृहाय
A square (in chess or any other game). -हाः (m. pl.)
A house, dwelling; इमे नो गृहाः
The inhabitants of a house, family; the life of a householder; गृहानुत्सृज्य यो राजन् मोक्षमेवाभिपद्यते
.-हः Ved. An assistant, or servant; गृहो याम्यरंकृतो देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहनः

. In comp. oft. rendered by 'domestic', 'household' or 'tame'; e. g. ˚कपोतः 'a tame pigeon'; ˚कार्याणि-कर्माणि 'household duties'; ˚ शकु- न्तिका 'tame bird'; छद्मना परिददामि मृत्यवे सौनिको गृहशकुन्तिका- मिव
&c. -Comp. -अक्षः a loophole, eyelet-hole, a round or ablong window.
a regent of a sign of the zodiac. संशयस्थः see अनुपात. -अयनिकः a house-holder. -अर्थः domestic affairs, any household matter; गृहार्थो$ग्निपरि- ष्क्रिया

. -अभिपालिन् m. a watchman. -अम्लम् a kind of sour-gruel. -अवग्रहणी the threshold. -अश्मन् m. a flat ablong stone upon which condiments are ground (Mar. पाटा). -आगत a. one who has come to a house. (-तः) a guest. -आचारः household or domestic business;
. -आरामः, -वाटी, -वाटिका a garden attached to a house. -आशया, -आश्रया the betel-tree. -आश्रमः the order of a householder, the second stage in the religious life of a Bāhmaṇa; see आश्रम;
. -ईश्वरी a housewife; दिष्ट्या गृहेश्वर्यसकृन्मयि त्वया कृतानुवृत्तिर्भवमोचनी खलैः
.-उत्पातः any domestic nuisance. -उपकरणम् a domestic utensil, anything required for household use; एकदा निर्गता क्रेतुं गृहोपकरणानि सा
. -कच्छपः = गृहाश्मन् q. v.-कन्या, -कुमारी the plant Aloe Perfoliata (Mar. कोरफड).-कपोतः, -तकः a tame or domestic pigeon; Śi.4.52.
a carpenter; गृहकर्ता भवानेव देवानां हृदयेप्सितम्
a domestic rite. ˚करः, ˚कारः, ˚दासः a menial, domestic servant; शंभुस्वयंभुहरयो हरिणेक्षणानां येनाक्रियन्त सततं गृहकर्मदासाः
. -कलहः domestic feuds, intestine broils. -कारकः a housebuilder, mason; करोति तृणमृत्काष्ठैर्गृहं वा गृहकारकः
a kind of wasp.-कुक्कुटः a domestic cock. -कार्यम्, -कृत्यम् household affairs; सदा प्रहृष्टया भाव्यं गृहकार्येषु दक्षया
.-गोधा, -गोधिका the small house-lizard. -चुल्ली a house with two rooms contiguous to each other, but one facing west, the other east; Bṛi.
. -चेतस् a. thinking only of one's house;
. -ज, -जात a. born in the house (a slave &c.);
. -जनः family, members of a family, especially the wife;

. -जालिका deceit, disguise. -ज्ञानिन् (also गृहेज्ञानिन्) 'wise only in the inside of the house', inexperienced, stupid, foolish. -तटी a terrace in front of the house. -दारु n. a house-post; नरपतिबले पार्श्वायाते स्थितं गृहदारुवत्
. -दाहः setting a house on fire, incendiarism. -दासः a domestic slave. -दासी a female domestic slave; एकदा गृहदासीषु यशोदा नन्दगेहिनी । कर्मान्तर- नियुक्तासु निर्ममन्थ स्वयं दधि ॥
. -दीप्तिः f. the splendour or ornament of a house, a virtuous woman; प्रजनार्थं महाभागाः पूजार्हा गृहदीप्तयः
. -देवता the goddess of a house; (pl.) a class of household deities;
. -देहली the threshold of a house; यासां बलिः सपदि मद्गृहदेहलीनाम्
. -नमनम् wind. -नाशनः a wild pigeon. -नीडः a sparrow,
पतिः a householder; बामं गृहपतिं नय
; a man who has entered on the second stage of life, one who, after having completed his studies, is married and settled.
the virtue of a householder; i. e. hospitality.
the maintenance of the sacred and perpetual fire.
the head or judge of a village;
. -पत्नी Ved. 'the mistress of a house', the wife of the householder; गृहान् गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासः
पालः the guardian of a house.
. -पिण्डी f. the basement of a building; Kāmikāgama 5
. -पोतकः the site of a house, the ground on which it stands and which surrounds it. -पोषणम् maintenance of a household; तेन चास्य नियुक्ताभूत्स्वभार्या गृहपोषणे

. -प्रवेशः a solemn entrance into a house according to prescribed rites. -बभ्रुः a domestic ichneumon. -बलिः a domestic oblation, offering of the remnants of a meal to all creatures, such as animals, supernatural beings, and particularly household deities;
. ˚देवता a deity to whom a domestic oblation is offered.
भङ्गः one who is driven from his house, an exile.
failure, ruin or destruction of a house, firm &c.
भञ्जनम् breaking down or destroying a house.
causing the decay or ruin of a family. -भद्रकम् an audience-hall. -भर्तृ m. the master of a house; Bṛi.
. -भूमिः f. the site of a house. -भेदिन् a.
causing domestic quarrels.-भोजिन् m. an inmate of the same house, tenant; तस्मा- दप्यग्रहारान्ये जगृहुर्गृहभोजिनः Rāj.
. -मणिः a lamp.-माचिका a bat. -मार्जनी a female servant of the house; सख्योपेत्याग्रहीत्पाणिं यो$हं तद्गृहमार्जनी
. -मृगः a dog. -मेघः a multitude of houses;
one who performs the domestic rites or sacrifices; गृह- मेधास आ गत मरुतो माप भूतन
connected with the duties of a householder.
. -मेधिन् m. a householder, a married Brāhmaṇa who has a household; (गृहैर्दारैर्मेधन्ते संगच्छन्ते Malli.); प्रजायै गृहमेधिनाम्
(नी) the wife of a householder, a house-wife; न व्यचष्ट वरारोहां गृहिणीं गृहमेधिनीम्
the intellect based on the Sattva quality.-यज्ञः see गृहमेधः;
. -यन्त्रम् a stick or other instrument to which, on solemn occasions, flags are fastened; गृहयन्त्रपताकाश्रीरपौरादरनिर्मिता
.-रन्ध्रम् family-dissensions. -वाटिका, -वाटी a garden attached to a house. -वित्तः the owner of a house. -व्रतa. devoted to home. मतिर्न कृष्णे परतः स्वतो वा मिथो$भिपद्येत गृहव्रतानाम्
शुकः a domestic parrot, one kept for pleasure;
a domestic poet; आयातेन शुकैः सार्धं दत्ता गृहशुकेन यः । मुक्ताः प्राप्य प्रतिष्ठायां चक्रे ख्यातां शुकावलीम् ॥ Rāj.
. -स्थः a householder, one who has entered on the stage of a house-holder; संकटा ह्याहिताग्नीनां प्रत्यवायैर्गृहस्थता
;6.9. ˚आश्रमः the life of a householder; see गृहाश्रम. ˚धर्मः the duty of a householder. -स्थूणा the pillar of a house.
गृहयाय्यः [gṛhayāyyḥ], A householder; (according to Tv. the form गृहयाप्य given in शब्दकल्पद्रुम is not correct).
गृहयालु [gṛhayālu], a. Disposed to catch hold of or seize.
गृहवत् [gṛhavat], m. The possessor of a house, house-holder; तथान्यासामपि विभुर्गृहेषु गृहवानिव
गृहा [gṛhā] हो [hō] लिका [likā], (हो) लिका A small house-lizard.
गृहिणी [gṛhiṇī], 'The mistress of a house', a wife, house-wife; (the lady in charge of the house); न गृहं गृहमित्याहु- र्गृहिणी गृहमुच्यते । गृहं तु गृहिणीहीनं कान्तारादतिरिच्यते
.-Comp. -पदम् the position or dignity of the mistress of the house; यान्त्येवं गृहिणीपदं युवतयो वामाः कुलस्याधयः Ś.4.18; स्थिता गृहिणीपदे 19.
गृहिन् [gṛhin], a. [गृह-इनि] Possessing a house. -m. The master of a house, a householder; पीड्यन्ते गृहिणः कथं नु तनयाविश्लेषदुःखैर्नवैः Ś.4.6;
Taken, seized, caught, held, grasped, laid hold of; केशेषु गृहितः.
Worn (see ग्रह्). -Comp. -अर्थ a. knowing the meaning or sense; अग्रहीतार्थे आवाम् Ś.6. -गर्भा a pregnant woman.
disappeared. -देह a. incarnate.-नामन् a. called by name; मया गृहीतनामानः स्पृश्यन्त इव पाप्मना

; सु˚ 'whose name is auspiciously invoked' a respectful way of speaking of venerable or dead persons. -विद्य a. versed in science, learned. -वेतन a. paid, remunerated. -श्वापद a. the beasts in which are confined or tracked.
गृहीतिन् [gṛhītin], a. Who has grasped or comprehended (with loc.); गृहीती षट्स्वङ्गेषु
गृहीभू [gṛhībhū], To serve as a house; तरुमूलानि गृहीभवन्ति तेषाम् Ś.7.2.
गृह् [gṛh], 1 Ā. To accept, to take, to seize; L. D. B.
To be attracted or pleased, as in गुणगृह्य q. v.
Domestic; गृह्याणां चैव देवानां नित्यपुष्पबलि- क्रिया
Situated out-side of; ग्रामगृह्या सेना 'an army out-side a village.'
Adhering to the party of, being in close relation to; तमार्यगृह्यम्
ह्यः The inmate of a house.
.-Comp. -अग्निः a sacred fire which every Brāhmaṇa is enjoined to maintain.
To be trusted or relied on; to be honored.
Taking the side of, adopting or choosing as best.
गृह्या [gṛhyā], A village adjoining to a city; a suburb.
